name: Traxler Counter-Attack — White Tactics
description: 4 tactical challenges for White in the Traxler Counter-Attack. Find the winning 2-move sequence to consolidate and win material against Black's sacrificial attack.

drills.name: King Escape to d3
drills.description: White runs the king to safety.
drills.briefExplanation: White runs the king to safety.
drills.explanation: d3 attacks the knight. White continues with 9.Kd3 and 10.Qf3, consolidating and winning material.

drills.name: Queen Check on f3
drills.description: White attacks the knight and checks.
drills.briefExplanation: White attacks the knight and checks.
drills.explanation: Qxe4 wins the knight. White follows with 10.Qf3, keeping the attack alive.

drills.name: d4 Central Push
drills.explanation: dxc5 opens lines. White continues with 10.Qf3, winning material.

drills.name: Bg5 Pin
drills.explanation: Bxf6 damages Black's structure. White follows with 11.Qf3, winning decisive material.
